label: Now Developing
items: Davao Mayor Sebastian Duterte testified September 29 that he did not know of his sister's GenCorp interest; the impeachment court also refused to compel her answers on bank records.
The Supreme Court dismissed challenges to the Senate's impeachment vote rule without deciding the constitutional question.
Jeepney minimum fares rose September 28 as a strike began; the BSP forecast September inflation at 6.4% to 7.4%.
